name: Storage Report
author: Misty
overview: Storage Report explains where a local folder's space is going with a recursive, read-only scan that never follows symlinks.
capabilities: Summarize file and folder counts and total bytes
Sort the largest files and review file-type distribution
Report unreadable or skipped entries with cancellable progress
permissions: Read-only access to the selected local folder
getting_started: Select one local folder in Files.
Open Storage Report and choose Scan folder.
Sort the result or refresh it after the folder changes.
changelog: v0.3.0 - Initial production release with symlink-safe scanning, cancellation, largest files, and type distribution.
